ext.description: Codex, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and every other CodexBar provider in the VS Code status bar — read from the codexbar CLI of the machine the extension runs on (works over Remote-SSH).
cmd.refresh.title: Refresh usage
cmd.showDetails.title: Show usage details
cmd.openSettings.title: Open settings
config.title: CodexBar Usage
config.executable.desc: Path or name of the codexbar CLI. Resolved on the machine hosting the workspace (remote when using Remote-SSH).
config.extraPath.desc: Extra PATH entries prepended when looking for codexbar (Homebrew dirs are not always on the extension host PATH).
config.refreshMode.desc: How often the status bar refreshes. CodexBar itself uses an adaptive cadence, so 'adaptive' is the default.
config.refreshMode.adaptive: Match CodexBar's behaviour: poll slowly when idle, faster as the weekly window fills up, and refresh when the window regains focus.
config.refreshMode.off: Never poll automatically; refresh only from the detail dialog or the command palette.
config.refreshMinutes.desc: Interval used when the refresh mode is 'fixed'.
config.refreshOnFocus.desc: Refresh when the VS Code window regains focus (mimics CodexBar refreshing when its menu opens). Throttled to once a minute.
config.warnThreshold.desc: Used percentage at which the status bar turns into the warning colour.
config.errorThreshold.desc: Used percentage at which the status bar turns into the error colour.
config.providers.desc: Providers to query. Leave empty to use whatever CodexBar itself has enabled (recommended: `codexbar usage` with no `--provider` only returns the providers you turned on in CodexBar). Fill in ids such as `codex`, `claude`, `gemini`, `cursor` to force a specific set.
config.statusBarLimit.desc: How many providers appear in the status bar (ranked by the most consumed window). Everything always shows in the hover card and the detail dialog.
config.metric.desc: Whether percentages show what is left or what has been used.
config.metric.remaining: Show the remaining share of each window.
config.metric.used: Show the consumed share of each window.
config.showCounters.desc: Also show secondary counters (banked credits, reset credits) in the collapsed status bar item.
config.inheritCodexBar.desc: Read CodexBar's own configuration (`~/.config/codexbar/config.json` and the CodexBar defaults) for the enabled provider set, refresh cadence, sort order and personal-info masking — so CodexBar stays the single place you configure things.
config.sortOrder.desc: Order of the segments in the status bar.
config.sortOrder.codexbar: Follow CodexBar's own menu-bar preferences (highest usage, or alphabetical).
config.hiddenProviders.desc: Provider ids to keep out of the status bar and the detail views, even when CodexBar has them enabled. Example: `["tavily"]`.
